nodes.title: Schwarz lemma on the upper half-plane

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{H}=\{z\in\mathbb{C} : \mathrm{Im}\,z>0\}$ be the upper half-plane, and let $f$ be a complex function that is holomorphic on $\mathbb{H}$, maps $\mathbb{H}$ into $\mathbb{H}$, and satisfies $f(i)=i$ and $f(2i)=\frac{15}{8}i$. Then the iterates $f^{\circ n}(2i)$ converge to $i$ as $n\to\infty$, where $f^{\circ n}$ is the $n$-fold composite of $f$ with itself.
